submission.justification: Algorithm-L2 at 33 GeV threshold achieves the highest signal efficiency of 93.225% at the allocated 8 kHz trigger rate. Through systematic simulation testing across all three candidate algorithms and multiple threshold values in the 20-60 GeV range, this configuration consistently outperformed all alternatives. Algorithm-L2 (iterative topological clustering with learned calibration) provides significantly better efficiency than Algorithm-L3 (86.3% at 35 GeV) and Algorithm-L1 (74.0% at 35 GeV). The 33 GeV threshold represents the optimal operating point for L2, providing better performance than neighboring thresholds (31 GeV: 91.1%, 32 GeV: 92.4%, 34 GeV: 91.0%, 35 GeV: 92.0%). All candidate algorithms were pre-vetted to fit within FPGA resource budgets (LUTs, DSPs) and optical link bandwidth, and as listed candidates they meet the latency constraint of ≤4.0 μs. This recommendation maximizes signal efficiency while satisfying all constraints.
